context:
Goal: reviewed work lands without waiting on a CI run that never starts.
Problem (rule): lane lint reads #3126 (a cp of another agent's file keeps that agent as writer) as unknown because no lane-touched-tests run started on any head after cb15b3758, and only your typed override lifts an unknown.
Based on (read): #3126 at head 10d984931 has a done review record (rounds 1 to 3, net value positive), and its lane ran the whole test family locally, 171 of 171 passing; the change is guard tests and docs only.
Departs from: main, where lane lint holds a PR until a touched-tests run exists — lifts that hold for #3126 alone, on the lane's local run.

options.gain: #3126 joins the next batch; the batch run still runs every suite before merge.
options.how: Open the lane's session and paste: merge --lane-lint 3126 --lint-unknown-ok "no lane-touched-tests run exists on the head, Actions started none after cb15b3758; the family ran 171 of 171 locally and the change is guard tests and docs only"
options.label: Type the override
options.lose: The Windows and macOS runs of the touched tests are skipped before the batch.

options.gain: The touched tests run on every platform before the batch.
options.how: #3126 waits until a touched-tests run exists on its head (step draft-push-starts-touched-run).
options.label: Wait for a run
options.lose: #3126 waits with no date, because nothing starts that run today.

reply: Withdrawn 10:52 CST Nov 13 by triage: nothing for you to type. #3126's run was missing because the PR conflicted with main, and GitHub starts no run on a conflicted PR. The lane merged main (head 5afe5513c), so the run starts on its own (coordinator 10:51 CST). Undo: reopen this item.
short: Let #3126 pass lint with no test run
title: Type the override that lets #3126 pass lane lint with no touched-tests run
why: The lane lint reads unknown because GitHub started no touched-tests run on #3126's head, and only your typed word lifts an unknown.
